# `hs-run fix` — state map

<!-- generated by render_state_map.py — edit the SSOT, # learn: "${HARNESS_BIN_ROOT:-.}"/harness/data/hs-run-registry.d/<domain>.yaml, not this file -->

Every state `hs-run fix` can report, with what it means. Run the CLI, read the `state`, do the judgment that state names, run it again — each state is re-derived from artifacts on disk, so deleting an artifact regresses the state.

This file is generated. Change the source named in the comment above, then re-render with `render_state_map.py`; edits made here are lost on the next render.

## States that route something

The CLI hands these rule and reference paths over at the moment the step begins — the body does not repeat them.

| state | what it means | routes |
|---|---|---|
| `no_plan_resolved` | No plan resolved, so the push-stage gate cannot clear and a verification has nowhere to be written. Build and commit the fix if you like — just do not expect the stage gate to pass until a plan exists. | `no-orphan-code`, `references/triage-and-scope.md`, `references/minimal-fix-discipline.md` |
| `needs_review` | No PASS review-decision is recorded for this plan and its measured diff did not earn a waiver (over a size threshold, risk tier above tiny, or the work could not be sized). Spawn the reviewer and record the verdict — reviewing your own fix is what this gate prevents. | `workflow-handoffs`, `references/verify-and-gate.md`, `references/regression-test.md` |
| `gate_blocked` | The review passed but the push-stage gate refuses. The reason names the missing or malformed receipt; fix that rather than re-running the review. | `references/verify-and-gate.md` |
| `ready` | Review PASSED and the stage gate clears. Whether the ROOT CAUSE is fixed rather than a symptom patched is not readable from disk — confirm that before shipping. | `tdd-discipline`, `references/verify-and-gate.md` |
| `stuck` | This domain has answered the same thing enough times in a row that repeating it is no longer an attempt. Stop re-running and spawn `hs:escalation-consultant` for counsel — hand it the task, the evidence as file:line, what was already tried, and the specific question. It advises; the decision stays here. | `orchestration-protocol`, `agent-operational-discipline` |

## States that route nothing

Not a gap: each is fully served by the `next_action` line the envelope already carries, and needs no extra file to act on.

| state | what it means |
|---|---|
| `codemap_offer` | This step reads code facts and the repo has no code map yet. Ask the user once; either answer ends the offer for this session, then run the step again and take its real answer (it is kept in `deferred`). |
| `facts_stale` | The code-graph snapshot backing this fix's `code.importers`/`code. tests_reached` facts is missing or older than HEAD within its own roots — run the named refresh command, then retry. The review-gate question itself is unchanged underneath; only the fact could not answer. |
